spanish: Y las basas de bronce, a las columnas; ganchos de las columnas y sus bandas de plata, y chapado de plata de sus cabezas, y ellos bandeados de plata; todas las columnas del atrio.
grammarChanges: Reordered 'de bronce' to follow 'basas' instead of 'columnas' so bronze predicates the bases, not the pillars, per the cited fail on h02038017001-h02038017003.
Reordered 'de plata' to follow 'chapado' instead of 'cabezas' so silver predicates the overlay construct (chapado de sus cabezas), not only the heads, per the cited fail on h02038017008-h02038017010.
readerNote: The article 'las' before 'columnas' is supplied for natural Spanish; the Hebrew token (h02038017002) is an absolute plural noun with no article in its morphology.
